decisions.reason: This navigation and observation camera sits close to the firm's core camera heritage and had its own page, so in a market with long qualification cycles the firm will keep it.
The modular multi-model navigation camera line matches the firm's push toward flexible sensors for small satellites and serves a growing market.
Space situational awareness is a growing, publicly funded field that builds on the firm's optical know-how, so the suite is likely to be kept.
The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website but fits the firm's docking and miniaturization strategy, so it will likely continue being developed and offered.
The new radiation-hard camera line has its own page and is close to the firm's core offering, so it fits demand for robust imaging and will be kept.
The asteroid navigation camera is likely tied to a specific mission, and its mention as heritage on the website will probably remain even if follow-on demand is niche.
